tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search over the CoinsPay API docs: guides, methods, webhook events and objects. Returns the best matching parts with the section to read in full with get_doc.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: The table of contents: every section of the CoinsPay API docs with a one-line summary, plus the key facts (API address, auth, test keys, webhooks).

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: One section of the CoinsPay API docs in Markdown: a guide, a group of methods with parameters, fields and errors, the webhook events or the objects.
